response.rationale: Biopsy-proven amyloid deposition localized to the urethra with no systemic involvement and a stenotic segment on imaging best fits primary urethral amyloidosis. R4 is too broad (systemic amyloidosis) and lacks supporting systemic findings; R1 is excluded by negative biopsy; R3 describes the imaging consequence, not the underlying diagnosis.

rejected.why: Biopsy was negative for carcinoma, directly contradicting urothelial carcinoma.
Urethral stenosis is a secondary imaging finding, not the primary etiologic diagnosis.
Systemic evaluation showed no additional amyloid manifestations, so systemic amyloidosis is unsupported.
